suffer.line: I would have sired many sons and I would not have suffered
stanza: If I had been God, I would have rearranged the veins

To alcohol and less prone to aging
If I had been God
I would have sired many sons and I would not have suffered
The Romans to kill even one of them
If I had been God with my staff and my rod
If I had been given the nod
I believe I could have done a better job
There's a lover in the story
But the story's still the same
There's a lullaby for suffering
And a paradox to blame
But it's written in the scriptures
And it's not some idle claim
You want it darker
We kill the flame

suffer.line: I can't believe that the axis turns on suffering
stanza: I can't believe that the axis turns on suffering
When you taste so good
I can't believe that the axis turns on suffering
When my headache burns

suffer.line: You said you hate my suffering
stanza: You said you hate my suffering
And you understood
And you’d take care of me
You'd always be there
Well where are you now?

suffer.line: Those who have suffered understand suffering
stanza: Those who have suffered understand suffering
And thereby extend their hand
The storm that brings harm
Also makes fertile blessed is the grass
And herb and the true thorn and light

suffer.line: There's too much pain, too much suffering
stanza: The whole world's broke and it ain't worth fixing
It's time to start all over, make a new beginning
There's too much pain, too much suffering
Let's resolve to start all over, make a new beginning
Now don't get me wrong. I love life and living
But when you wake up and look around at everything
That's going down
All wrong
You see we need to change it now
This world with too few happy endings

Make a new beginning
When you believe in things
That you don't understand
Then you suffer
